draft_key_information_units.information: Record financial performance in 2024 with revenue of EUR 216.6 mln, EBITDA of EUR 89.8 mln, and all-time best annual net profit of EUR 29.6 mln.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: 2024 at a glance section and consolidated statement of profit and loss: revenue EUR 216.6 mln, EBITDA EUR 89.8 mln, profit for the period EUR 29.6 mln (up from EUR 24.5 mln in 2023).

draft_key_information_units.information: Net financing portfolio reached EUR 371.2 mln at year-end 2024, representing 16% growth from 2023.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: 2024 at a glance and consolidated statement of financial position: Vehicle and Consumer Financing Net Portfolio EUR 371.2 mln; total assets EUR 476.3 mln (up from EUR 421.3 mln).

draft_key_information_units.information: Successful IPO in October 2024, the largest in Nasdaq Riga’s history, raising EUR 29.0 mln in equity and strengthening capital base.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Keynote from the CEO: IPO completed in October 2024 securing EUR 29.0 mln in equity; share capital increased to EUR 1,171,088 with share premium of EUR 25.5 mln.

draft_key_information_units.information: Integration of Sub-Saharan operations acquired in 2023, resulting in tripling of the combined portfolio size across the three main markets in the region.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Keynote from the CEO: Completed integration of Sub-Saharan operations acquired in 2023 with tangible business growth and tripling of combined portfolio size.

draft_key_information_units.information: Sustainability milestone: Financed nearly 2,000 electric motorcycles in Eastern Africa, covering over 20 mln kilometers and saving an estimated 1,000 metric tonnes of CO2, reaching the 2025 goal one year early.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Keynote from the CEO: Financed nearly 2,000 electric motorcycles saving 1,000 metric tonnes of CO2 and reaching 2025 goal ahead of schedule.

draft_key_information_units.information: Total number of active customers reached 326,862 at year-end 2024.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: 2024 at a glance: Total Number of Active Customers 326,862.

draft_key_information_units.information: Equity increased to EUR 108.1 mln at year-end 2024 (from EUR 65.4 mln in 2023), driven by IPO proceeds and retained earnings.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Consolidated statement of financial position and statement of changes in equity: Total equity EUR 108.1 mln (up from EUR 65.4 mln); share premium increase of EUR 25.5 mln from IPO.

draft_key_information_units.information: Continued focus on digitalization, risk management, and operational efficiency, with nearly doubling of loan applications received compared to the previous year.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Keynote from the CEO: Advanced digitalization efforts, nearly doubling applications; improved portfolio quality and operational efficiency.

evaluation.selection_rationale: Selected 8 units prioritizing headline financial results (revenue, EBITDA, net profit, portfolio), major capital event (IPO), key strategic/operational developments (Sub-Saharan integration, digitalization, sustainability), and supporting metrics (customers, equity growth). Units are independently omittable, drawn directly from SOURCE with no invented causality or boilerplate. REFERENCE guided emphasis on record performance and dividend context but was not used as exhaustive ground truth.
